Title: Exam list read
Steps: Call examApi.listExams() and inspect the recorded request and the resolved value
Expected: GET /api/exams is issued and the resolved array holds the exam id and title unchanged

Title: passingScore normalization
PreConditions: pg returns the numeric/decimal column as a string
Steps: 1. Call examApi.listExams() with a string decimal 2. Call it with null
Expected: passingScore is coerced to the number 60.5 in the first case and stays null in the second

Title: Exam 403 error mapping
PreConditions: The caller is not an instructor
Expected: Rejects with an ApiError carrying status 403 and message 'Forbidden'

Title: Grading queue limit param
Expected: GET /api/exams/grading/queue is issued with params.limit equal to 50 (the default) then 25

Title: Grading queue unusable scores
PreConditions: An attempt is ungraded or the DB column yields an unexpected value
Steps: Call examApi.getGradingQueue() and inspect the row
Expected: Both score and maxScore resolve to null in both cases so the UI shows a placeholder and never renders NaN

Title: Grading queue decimal scores
PreConditions: pg returns the numeric/decimal column as a string
Steps: Call examApi.getGradingQueue() and inspect the row
Expected: score resolves to the number 8.5 and maxScore to 10

Title: KPI row and exam table
PreConditions: Instructor seeded in the auth store; listExams and getGradingStats and getGradingQueue mocked at the module boundary
Steps: 1. Render AnalyticsPage 2. Wait for the 2 exam rows 3. Assert the KPI values; the no-time-series block; and both rows
TestData: 2 exams (graded/proctored/45min and practice/unproctored/null timeLimit); pending=2; graded=9; oldestPending=null; queue with 2 rows for e-1
Expected: The h1 reads 'Phan tich'; the KPI cards read 1 exam count and 2 pending and 9 graded and an em-dash for the oldest pending; the no-time-series block renders; the e-1 row shows '45 phut' and 'Bat' with pending count 2; the e-2 row shows the em-dash for a null time limit and 'Tat' and pending count 0

Title: Analytics empty state
PreConditions: Instructor seeded; listExams returns an empty list
Steps: Render AnalyticsPage and wait for the no-exams copy
TestData: listExams=[] with pending=0 and graded=0 and oldestPending=null
Expected: The 'Ban chi co bai thi nao' copy renders in the table; the KPI cards read 0 and 0 and 0 and the em-dash for the oldest pending; and no exam row is rendered

Title: Analytics route and guard and testids and console errors
PreConditions: Dev server on :3000; valid instructor storageState; all three reads intercepted with page.route
Steps: 1. Open /instructor/analytics 2. Assert the URL is unchanged 3. Assert the data-testids and the row contents 4. Assert the KPI values 5. Assert zero console errors
TestData: 1 exam; pending=2; graded=9; oldestPending=null; queue 2 rows for e-1
Expected: URL stays /instructor/analytics so the instructor guard passes; instructor-analytics-kpis / -trend-empty / -rows / -row are present; the row shows 'React Midterm' and '45 phut' and 'Bat'; the KPIs read 1 and 2 and 9 and the em-dash; zero console errors
